At the beginning, delete the entire picture and dialogue showing the salt tied-up, the accountant coming and emptying him, the safe being found empty and him weeping, the accountant asking under which account this loss should be entered, the salt sending him to the police (upto and including the exclamation Jagat Ram).
Delete the picture of Vooravundur distributing the robbed articles among slum dwellers (there is no objection to her parting with her depette to a poor boy sitting there).
